descriptor: Turn your AI chats into links you’ll be proud to share.
sampleTitle: A calmer way to build with AI

directions.name: Folio
headline: Your thinking,
worth sharing.
directions.mantra: Give good work a good form.
directions.rationale: The approved type and palette, with a new page-turn symbol. Editorial pride remains the main idea.
directions.alt: A fan of ivory book pages with a muted vermilion ribbon.
directions.markRationale: Three paper planes open around a clear fold. A compact mark derived from the sculptural book.

directions.name: Folio
headline: Your thinking,
worth sharing.
directions.mantra: Give good work a good form.
directions.rationale: The same Folio identity with more emphasis on the share. A ribbon becomes the signature; the primary logo is the wordmark.
directions.alt: A fan of ivory book pages with a muted vermilion ribbon.
directions.markRationale: A folded ribbon serves as the small signature. The full name leads without a separate icon.

directions.name: Waymark
headline: Share your thinking.
Leave a trail.
directions.mantra: A little shared today. A wider path tomorrow.
directions.rationale: The trail idea, with a small cairn instead of rising squares. Each shared thought becomes a point along the way.
directions.alt: A sparse trail of small ochre pebbles and ivory paper fragments branching over pale sand.
directions.markRationale: Three low, rounded stones make a waypoint. A small piece of evidence that someone passed this way.

directions.name: Along
directions.territory: A little shared along the way
headline: Share your thinking.
Leave a trail.
directions.mantra: Share as you go. Let the work add up.
directions.rationale: A warmer name for the trail concept, paired with Folio’s approved type and colors. Share as you go; let a body of work emerge.
directions.alt: A sparse trail of small ochre pebbles and ivory paper fragments branching over pale sand.
directions.markRationale: A gently curving route and a separate next step keep the trail open. The shape stays human and unhurried.
